why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check you are allowed in. The terms say: "We currently do not permit participation by persons located in or associated with the United States or any sanctioned country." The list of other excluded countries is below.
Open defi.xstocks.fi/points from a link you typed yourself, connect that wallet and sign the message to register. Registering means you accept the xPoints terms. Never enter a seed phrase anywhere.
Hold the xStocks, or supply them to a lending market or a liquidity pool that accepts them. Points are tracked automatically.
Do the extras if you want: the daily spin, the social quests, protocol quests and your referral link.
Optionally, until 4 December 2026, buy xStocks inside Solflare for the 5% to 20% boost. Solflare does not sell xStocks in the US, Canada, the UK, Australia or Nigeria.
Stay active. "New accounts that show no activity and no eligibility within 7 days of registration will be automatically removed."
costs: Registering a wallet is free apart from signing a message. Earning points is not: you need xStocks in the wallet, which means buying tokenized shares with real money. Every buy, transfer, deposit into a lending market or pool, and withdrawal pays network gas. Solflare says it charges no fee of its own on xStocks trades, only the Solana network fee.
